questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the past perfect tense?
options: She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
She said she _____ to London before she moved there.
questions.answer: She said she had been to London before she moved there.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: 'I wish I _____ more time to finish the project.'
Which conditional sentence is used to talk about unlikely future situations?
options: If it rains, we will cancel the picnic.
If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If she had called, we could have met.
questions.answer: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.

questions.question: Select the correct modal verb for the sentence: 'You should _____ the doctor if you feel unwell.'
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: I have been living here for five years.
I am living here for five years.
I was living here for five years.
I will be living here for five years.
questions.answer: I have been living here for five years.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct comparative form: 'My apartment is _____ than yours.'
Which sentence correctly uses the infinitive form?
options: I remember to lock the door.
I remember that lock the door.
